# Introduction

Campus health centres experience fluctuations in patient demand due to seasonal illnesses, examination periods, weather conditions, and other factors. This project aims to develop an analytics-based solution to forecast demand and support better resource allocation.

# Problem Statement

The campus health centre faces challenges in predicting patient demand, resulting in long waiting times, inefficient staff allocation, and medicine shortages.

# Objectives

- Forecast daily patient demand.
- Predict appointment no-shows.
- Analyze disease trends.
- Improve doctor scheduling.
- Support data-driven decision making.

# Proposed Methodology

1. Collect or create dataset.
2. Perform data cleaning.
3. Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis.
4. Build prediction models.
5. Develop an analytics dashboard.
6. Generate business recommendations.

# Current Status

Project initialized.

Dataset collection is under progress.
